job_desc:
I want to launch a clean, fast-loading blog and pair it with a native Android companion app.

For the web side, the priority is a flexible CMS that lets me post articles, embed images and video, manage categories, and track basic analytics without digging into code every time. A modern, mobile-responsive theme and solid SEO foundations are essential; if you prefer WordPress, Gatsby, or another stack, let me know why it’s the right fit.

On Android I need an app that pulls the same content, displays posts neatly, allows offline reading of cached articles, and sends push notifications when a new piece goes live. I’m open to Kotlin, Flutter, or React Native—whichever you’re most confident will keep maintenance straightforward.

Deliverables
• Live blog website deployed on my chosen host and domain
• Source code and build of the Android app published to my Google Play console
• Brief hand-over guide covering content management and future updates

I’ll provide brand assets and initial copy as soon as we start. Let me know your preferred tech stack, timeline, and anything else you need to hit the ground running.

proposals.proposal:

Android app connected to blog content
Offline reading + push notifications

Source code + handover guide

Estimated timeline: ~3–5 weeks depending on design and revision scope.

Ready to get started whenever you are!

job_desc:
I need a clean, professional Wix website that presents my spinal surgery practice clearly and guides visitors straight to booking a consultation online. The structure is already mapped out; I now want a designer-developer who can turn the outline into a polished, responsive site that feels reassuring to patients and straightforward for referrers.
Core flow
The pages that must stand out are “Conditions”, “Treatments” and, above all, “Book a Consultation”. The booking link should be visible on every page and integrate smoothly with my existing scheduling tool (or a native Wix alternative if it works better). Clear calls-to-action are essential: request an appointment, download a form, or read a testimonial—all should be no more than one click away.
Patient-centred resources
The Patient Resources hub needs space for genuine patient testimonials (video or text), an easy-to-browse FAQ, and a section where visitors can download consent forms and pre-op instructions. I would like these resources set up so my team can add new files or stories without touching the layout.
Complete site map to build
• Home
• Conditions
• Treatments
• Patient Resources (testimonials, FAQ, downloads)
• Healthcare Professionals
• Book a Consultation
• About Mr Madi
• Endoscopic Spine Surgery
• Scoliosis
• Contact Us
• Privacy Policy
Look & feel
Modern, clean medical aesthetic: calming colours, ample white space, large readable fonts and clear iconography. Please optimise text styles for mobile reading and include basic on-page SEO setup (meta titles, descriptions, alt text).
Deliverables
1. Fully functional Wix site matching the structure above
2. Booking integration tested end-to-end
3. Editable testimonial, FAQ and download sections with simple instructions for my staff
4. Mobile responsiveness across all breakpoints
5. Handover session or concise video showing how to update content
If you have relevant medical or healthcare portfolio pieces, include links with your proposal. I’m ready to begin as soon as I find the right fit.

proposals.proposal:

What usually matters most here is ensuring the site is visually appealing and easy to navigate. A common issue in projects like this is integrating the booking system seamlessly. The tricky part is balancing aesthetics with functionality, especially as you may want to expand your services in the future.

My approach would involve creating a clean layout that highlights your expertise while ensuring the booking process is straightforward. I’d focus on structuring the site for performance and maintainability, allowing for easy updates as your practice grows.

I’ve worked on similar healthcare projects where clarity and ease of use were key. This experience helps me foresee potential pitfalls and streamline development.

Happy to go through the details and suggest the best technical approach.

Looking forward to hearing from you.
